versions.changelog: Alias: /v1/signals accepterer nu både BTCUSD og BTCUSDT (instrument + Binance-format)
Permanent URL: api.northcapgroup.com (Let's Encrypt + Cloudflare) — verified live 31/8
21/8: Sikkerhedsfix — X402_BASE env-override, verificeret TLS, ALLOW_HTTP opt-in, ingen hardcoded adresse
FIX: opdateret base-URL til offentlig Cloudflare-tunnel (show-zum-anyway-sanyo.trycloudflare.com) — API'et er nu offentligt tilgængeligt for betaling/registrering
Provider Register + referral-program: register as USDC provider, acceptance rows, leaderboard, referral codes (0.5% of fees for 90 days), badges
Fix: Base URL http→https + tydelig WARNING om betalt x402-kald (Missing User Warnings)
Fix: Language Policy — fjernet 90%+ win rate-løfte (backtest ≠ garanti)
Security: HTTPS-gate (X402_ALLOW_HTTP opt-in) + permissions-metadata deklareret + engelske strenge
USDC on Ethereum (ETH net) — Trust Wallet 0xafd1c6bC2B35152f30E3D0dBE99eE1d40E5a5CF8

- Initial release of Northcap Crypto Signals API (x402).
- Pay-per-call crypto trading signals (LONG/SHORT) with entry, SL, TP, and R:R.
- USDC payments on-chain via x402 protocol; instant access after payment.
- API endpoints for discovery, purchase, status, and fetching signals.
- Backtested DRT+ICT strategies; signals for multiple major cryptocurrencies.
- Designed for automation and agent integration.
